title: Cancellation of the Larkspur Valuables Floater by the Named Insured
content:
## Cancellation of the Larkspur Valuables Floater by the named insured

**Condition.** The floater is cancelled only on a request the named insured has signed, effective no earlier than the date the request is received.

- The request must be signed by the named insured of that floater; the signed request is what the cancellation rests on.
- A floater may be cancelled while it is bound (before it takes effect) or while it is in force.
- On cancellation, coverage ends on the cancellation date and the cancellation credit is posted to the floater's premium account as return premium.

Hypothetical dates: a signed request received on 5 May that asks for cancellation from 1 May is effective no earlier than 5 May; a signed request received on 5 May that asks for cancellation from 5 May may be effective 5 May.

## The cancellation credit

**Rule.** The cancellation credit is the term premium plus the prorated premium of midterm item changes, taken pro rata from the cancellation date to the expiration date and rounded half-up to the cent, less the tier's short-rate retention percentage under a short-rate basis, less the term's installments not yet billed, and reduced so that at least the tier's minimum earned premium is kept.

The quantity is built in this order:

1. **Premium of the term.** The term premium, together with the prorated premium changes posted for the term's midterm item changes (additional premium adding, return premium subtracting).
2. **Unearned share.** That premium taken pro rata over the part of the term from the cancellation date to the expiration date, that is, multiplied by the calendar days from the cancellation date to the expiration date and divided by the calendar days in the term, rounded half-up to the cent.
3. **Short-rate retention.** Where the tier's basis is short rate, the tier's retention percentage of that unearned share is taken off. Under a pro-rata basis nothing is taken off at this point.
4. **Unbilled installments.** The term's installments not yet billed are taken off.
5. **Minimum earned premium.** The result is reduced where necessary so that the company keeps at least the tier's minimum earned premium.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, 365-day terms, no midterm item changes)

| Case | Working | Credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Select, annual plan, term premium 438.00 USD, 73 days left | 438.00 multiplied by 73 and divided by 365 gives 87.60; pro rata, nothing unbilled; 350.40 kept | 87.60 |
| Valuables Floater Classic, annual plan, term premium 120.00 USD, 219 days left | 120.00 multiplied by 219 and divided by 365 gives 72.00; less 10 percent (7.20) gives 64.80; 55.20 kept | 64.80 |
| Valuables Floater Select, annual plan, term premium 75.00 USD, 350 days left | 75.00 multiplied by 350 and divided by 365 gives 71.92; that would leave 3.08 kept, below 25.00, so the credit is reduced to leave 25.00 kept | 50.00 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred, quarterly plan, term premium 400.00 USD, 146 days left, installment 4 of 100.00 USD not yet billed | 400.00 multiplied by 146 and divided by 365 gives 160.00; less the unbilled 100.00 gives 60.00 | 60.00 |
